instruction: Configure Chrome to open with a specific set of pages on startup instead of the New Tab page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate to Chrome startup settings and configure it to open with specific pages (restore_on_startup=5). Evaluator verifies the setting by checking the Chrome Preferences file session.restore_on_startup field. The existing getter function get_new_startup_page is reused.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly returns 'false' when 'session' key is missing (line 48-49), properly detecting default Chrome state (New Tab page).

Complete verification: Getter checks both restore_on_startup==5 (lines 52-54) AND that startup_urls field exists and is non-empty (lines 57-59), ensuring 'specific set of pages' are actually configured as instruction requires.
Consistent error handling: Returns 'false' on error (line 66), maintaining consistency with expected boolean string values.
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to verify startup behavior after configuration changes.
